Repo boundary: packages/validator/pyproject.toml publishes `analitiq-validator` to PyPI via .github/workflows/validator-release.yml. Its header comment states the external consumers: "Consumers (the connector-builder plugin, the registry CI) `pip install analitiq-validator` and run the `analitiq-validate` console script" — i.e. the `main()`/`_JSON_READ_ERRORS` path is exercised, outside this repo, by the DIP registry's CI gate and by the connector-builder plugin; also the engine runtime and infra `pipeline-invoker`.
